items: The circle round the witch is gone: what stands in front of her now fades in a pass of its own, so trunks and crowns inside the circle no longer draw over each other in the wrong order
The see-through round the witch no longer smears everything outside a hard circle on some graphics cards
The canopy cut-away round her is about a third smaller, and its size is a slider on the pause page (Canopy cut-away)
The pause page has a See-through group for the circle hunt: its reach and opacity as sliders, its fade on or off, and a switch that tints whatever the see-through draws magenta
The pause page has a Circle report button: it draws the paused frame three ways and saves a picture and the numbers of where they differ
